title: Payload-integrity contract checker for low-bit function outputs (FP8/INT8)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a probabilistic JSON contract-checker and CI integration that quantifies and enforces structured-output fidelity for models served with FP8/INT8 profiles. The checker will run on calibration and CI datasets and produce per-field acceptance scores, suggested repair actions, and deployable rollbacks when fidelity drops below thresholds. This ticket covers the design, a reference implementation, and a short-term CI gate with metrics and dashboards.
acceptance_criteria: Reference implementation (Python) that accepts: model outputs (text), JSON schema, and quantization profile metadata and emits per-field pass/fail with probabilistic confidence scores.

CI hook that runs the checker on a 1k-sample calibration set within PRs touching runtime or quant profiles and fails the PR when schema_violation_rate > 0.1% or when critical fields show confidence < 95%.
Dashboard panel in Console showing rolling schema_violation_rate, per-field false-negative and false-positive estimates, and drift alerts for each quant profile (FP8, INT8 variants).

Automated mitigation workflow: on severity-high regression, trigger canary rollback to prior quant profile or fallback to a higher-precision variant and create an incident ticket with a calibration artifact attached.

Integration tests that simulate common failure modes (missing keys, wrong types, truncated arrays) and assert the checker suggests repair actions and relevant tokens to inspect in the KV cache replay traces.
implementation_notes: Design probabilistic contract: combine deterministic JSON Schema checks with a token-level confidence model derived from calibration runs (token logits mapped to per-field reliability).
Capture three kinds of failures: structural (missing/extra keys), type/format mismatch, and semantic truncation (truncated arrays/strings resulting from quantized decodes).
Calibration harness: run N=5 seeds x 2k samples for each quant profile to estimate per-field reliability distributions and store artifacts (calib-run-id) in S3 for auditability.
Use a lightweight Bayesian smoothing to avoid brittle pass/fail on low-frequency schema entries (e.g., enums seen < 30 times).
Expose checker as a small binary + HTTP endpoint for easy CI/runner integration and also a Python lib for local dev and calibration notebooks.
test_plan: Unit tests for schema comparator and token-confidence aggregator (coverage > 90%).

End-to-end test: serve a quantized model variant in a local runtime, run a 1k sample eval that contains synthetic edge cases (deeply nested objects, long arrays, optional fields) and verify metrics produce stable signals across seeds.

Fuzz suite: random mutational generation of function-call outputs to validate the checker’s false-positive rate is < 0.05 for non-quantized baseline and degrades gracefully for FP8/INT8 within expected budgets.
Performance test: checker CI run completes in <= 8 minutes for 1k-sample dataset when parallelized across 8 workers.
rollout_plan: Merge reference implementation behind feature flag runtime:quant-contract-checker.
Enable CI gate for PRs touching runtime/quant profiles on a subset of repos (sdk, serving-runtime) for two weeks (observability-only for first week, blocking for second).
Publish a how-to guide in Confluence (link below) and a short demo in the weekly eng sync.
After 2 successful cycles and validation, flip flag to on for all repos and add the dashboard tile to default console view for runtime teams.
